resources.string: Tell your friends if you don’t arrive
A friend hasn’t confirmed they arrived
Tell your friends where you are going. If you don’t confirm you arrived, they get an alert with your last position. As long as you answer, nothing is sent.
Without notifications you won’t see “Did you arrive?”, and your friends could be told without you being asked.
No friends in the app yet
The check-in tells friends in the app. Add one by scanning their code.

At the time you chose, the phone asks “Did you arrive?”. If you don’t answer within 10 minutes of the question, the friends you chose get the alert, with your last position. If the phone is off at that time, it asks when it’s back on and still gives you 10 minutes. Keep the app allowed in the background.
If you don’t answer before the countdown ends, these are told: %1$s.
None of the friends you chose for %1$s is in your list any more, so nobody was told.

No nickname and no way to answer
The report has no nickname and no way to answer: the team can’t write back and doesn’t know who you are. If you need help now, call 112 or go to a Safe Zone point.

Reports of harassment and “I feel unsafe”, by square of the site plan and by hour, the most first. For patrols only; the map is not shown to the public.

Anxiety, panic, too much at once

Anxiety, panic, too much at once: it happens and you are not alone. Say how you feel, and the welfare team can come to you or take you in at the Safe Zone. The message goes quietly, with your position.
Stay where you are, somewhere as quiet as you can, or go to the Safe Zone. The answer comes quietly, with no sound.
The organiser hasn’t set up a team here that answers through the app. Go to the nearest medical point or the Safe Zone and say how you feel.
Provisional text, not yet reviewed by the medical team.
Sit somewhere safe if you can, and lean your back on something.
Breathe in through your nose, slowly, counting to 4.
Breathe out through your mouth, even more slowly, counting to 6.
Repeat ten times. If you feel dizzy, breathe normally for a moment.
Then look around and name 5 things you can see.
If you have chest pain, can’t breathe or feel physically ill, call 112.
What to say, with your coordinates
The phone’s last position: %1$s. Walk to a numbered landmark and tell the operator what you see around you.
The phone has no position for you
Tell the operator the zone, the number of the landmark you can see and what is around you.
Read the coordinates below to the operator and say what you see around you.
The call’s position reaches the operator automatically only if the call connects. Say what you see around you too, so they can find you.
